decision_rules: Claim exact existing coverage only after binding an executable current Arena test and explaining its equivalence to the fixed candidate at the let annotation/value compatibility boundary.

Propose a single local package only if complete inventory and wiring review show a distinct executable gap and the expected outcome is supported as documented observer behavior or a permitted characterization.
Use an either outcome only with positive support that both outcomes are permitted; missing normative authority alone does not support either.
If expected-outcome support is unresolved, retain the fixed example and state a focused contract question without proposing a scored test outcome.
Historical Nanoda mutation evidence may establish local regression value but cannot establish a current Arena checker defect or semantic authority.
